description: Taifoon RPC (product taifoon.rpc): one JSON-RPC read through the gateway (POST /gw/rpc/{chainId}), the same on every chain the warmbed oracle rotates (GET /v1/rpc gateway.chains; always 8453, 5042, 1, 56, 43114, 42161, 137, 10, 4663, 42220, 36927, 3692781), and as history on the networks that no longer produce blocks (1284 Moonbeam, 1285 Moonriver, 1287 Moonbase Alpha: the head is final, reads come from archive endpoints, and the call answers "no upstream configured" while the rotation holds none). Methods: the standard reads (blocks, transactions, receipts, eth_getLogs at most 10,000 blocks, eth_call, balances, code, nonces, gas, eth_chainId) and taifoon_getProof [{ tx } | { block }] (the proof from the layer’s indexes); writes are refused. The request goes to the chain’s measured rotation of endpoints and fails over to the next one. Free: 1,000 requests a day per key (100 without one); past it, from the key’s balance at the catalogue price (0.5 USDC per 1M reads, 5 per 1M proved reads; taifoon_access view "package").

chain_id.description: a chain the gateway serves (GET /v1/rpc gateway.chains), e.g. 8453, 5042, 1; archive: 1284, 1285, 1287

name: taifoon_rpc
